mechanism: Periodic Liveness {{signal}}: An entity emits {{signal}} (Heartbeat) every interval I. Missing K consecutive heartbeats triggers failure detection. Heartbeat may include health metrics. Receiver tracks last-seen timestamp. It feeds into the {{quorum}} detector, allowing the collective to identify and prune dead nodes.
failure_modes: False failure detection: the node is alive and its heartbeat was delayed, so absence of signal was read as absence of the emitter.
Heartbeat outlives usefulness: the emitter is alive and the work it was doing is not, so liveness is reported while progress has stopped.
invariants: Missing `timeout_multiplier` consecutive intervals triggers failure DETECTION, which is a suspicion and not a fact about the emitter.
